gui.workbay.bay.empty.tip: Hold a machine and click here to rack it.
gui.workbay.bay.inert: Nothing can reach this machine on any face. It keeps running; no link can use it.
gui.workbay.bay.locked.tip: Install an Expansion Plate to open this bay.
gui.workbay.bay.rack.tip: Hold a machine and click to rack it in this bay.
gui.workbay.button.copy.tip: Copies this bay's face settings, so the next seven do not have to be set by hand.
gui.workbay.button.eject.tip: Take this machine out of its bay, with everything inside it.
gui.workbay.button.flow.tip: See what every link moves, and which flows never leave this block.
gui.workbay.button.lock.tip: A locked Workbay only lets its owner rack, eject or change anything.
gui.workbay.button.paste.tip: Replaces this bay's face settings with the ones you copied.
gui.workbay.button.rename.tip: Give this bay a name of your own. Return commits it, Escape leaves it alone, and an empty name goes back to the machine's.
gui.workbay.button.upgrades.tip: Install Expansion Plates, a Resonator or a Multichannel Upgrade.
gui.workbay.faces.empty: Rack a machine to set its faces.
gui.workbay.faces.role.input: Input. Links may push into this face.
gui.workbay.faces.role.none: Unset. With no face set, links use whichever face answers.
gui.workbay.faces.role.output: Output. Links may pull out of this face.
gui.workbay.faces.tip: The cube shows one resource type at a time, so a face can take items in and send energy out.
gui.workbay.links.bay.tip: The bay this link moves to and from. Every link belongs to exactly one.
gui.workbay.links.disable.tip: Click to stop this link without deleting it.
gui.workbay.links.enable.tip: A new link starts off, so nothing moves until you have looked at the row. Click to turn it on.
gui.workbay.links.filter.tip: Click to change which links this list shows.
gui.workbay.links.filterslot.tip: Drag an item here from the recipe list, or click while holding one, and this link moves only that item.
gui.workbay.links.internal.retarget.tip: Click to point this link at the next bay instead.
gui.workbay.links.internal.tip: Adds a link from the selected bay straight to another one, with no Connector and nothing to place in the world.
gui.workbay.links.mode.tip: Click to turn this link around.
gui.workbay.links.none: No links yet. Pair a Connector and place it on something.
gui.workbay.links.pair.tip: Pairs the Connector in your hand to this Workbay and the selected bay. Place it on the block you want linked.
gui.workbay.links.remove.tip: The Connector stays where it is. Right-click it to link it again.
gui.workbay.links.sort.added: In the order they were made
gui.workbay.links.type.tip: Click to change what this link carries.
gui.workbay.power.tip: Energy stored in the Workbay itself. Hosted machines keep their own.
gui.workbay.redstone.always.tip: This bay's links run whatever the redstone at the Workbay is doing. Click to change.
gui.workbay.redstone.pulse.tip: One operation each time the signal turns on, so a clock moves exactly one load per tick of the clock.
gui.workbay.redstone.with_signal.tip: This bay's links run only while the Workbay has a redstone signal.
gui.workbay.redstone.without_signal.tip: This bay's links run only while the Workbay has no redstone signal.
gui.workbay.status.connector_gone.tip: The Connector this link hangs off has been broken. The row clears itself shortly.
gui.workbay.status.disabled.tip: Turned off in this link's settings.
gui.workbay.status.held_by_redstone.tip: Waiting on this bay's redstone mode. Nothing is wrong; this is what you asked it to do.
gui.workbay.status.idle.tip: Nothing to move. This is the normal resting state.
gui.workbay.status.machine_no_face.tip: This bay has faces set, but none marked for this link's direction. Mark one in on the cube for a link that pulls, or out for one that sends. Setting every face back to unset uses whichever answers.
gui.workbay.status.machine_no_port.tip: The hosted machine answers on none of the faces this link may use. Check the cube, or eject and re-rack it.
This link is set to fluids, which this version does not move. Click the row's type icon to set it back to items or energy.
gui.workbay.status.running.tip: This link moved something on its last turn.
gui.workbay.status.target_missing.tip: The dimension this link points into is gone. Nothing will move until it comes back.
gui.workbay.status.target_no_port.tip: The target is there but has nothing this link can connect to on any face.
gui.workbay.status.target_not_loaded.tip: The target's chunk is unloaded. The link resumes on its own when somebody goes back.
gui.workbay.title: Workbay
gui.workbay.upgrade.multichannel.cost: Costs 4 Levy and an Amethyst Shard to craft.
gui.workbay.upgrade.resonator.cost: Costs 4 Levy and an Ender Eye to craft.
gui.workbay.upgrades.maxed: You have as many of these as a Workbay takes.
gui.workbay.upgrades.tax: Tax rate: %s%% — the Assay is not built yet
message.workbay.break_warning: Breaking this Workbay leaves its bays behind. The machines keep running — place any fresh Workbay to get back in, or find this one again with code %s.
message.workbay.connector_full: This Connector already carries everything it can. Install a Multichannel Upgrade to carry items, fluids and energy on one.
message.workbay.connector_linked: Linked to %s. Workbay %s has a row for it, switched off until you turn it on.
message.workbay.connector_no_workbay: The Workbay this Connector is paired to isn't loaded. Go back to it and place this again.
message.workbay.connector_paired: Connector paired to Workbay %s. Place it against the block you want to link.
message.workbay.connector_unpaired: This Connector isn't paired yet. Right-click a Workbay with it first.
message.workbay.internal_link_needs_seco: This Workbay only has one bay. Install an Expansion Plate before linking bay to bay.
message.workbay.network_cap_reached: You already own the maximum of %s Workbay network(s). Break one before starting another.
message.workbay.network_deployed_full: This network already has %s Workbay(s) placed. Break one of them before placing another.
message.workbay.network_reused: Workbay %s reconnected — same bays, same links, same upgrades as before.
message.workbay.pair_needs_connector: Hold a Connector to pair one.
message.workbay.reject.assay_needs_bay: The Assay only works racked in a bay. It has no faces to connect to out here.
message.workbay.reject.kinetic: %s runs on rotational force. A bay can't turn a shaft.
message.workbay.reject.multiblock: %s is part of a multiblock. A bay holds one block; build it in a room instead.
message.workbay.reject.needs_neighbours: %s works by connecting to the blocks around it. A bay has no neighbours to connect to.
message.workbay.reject.no_bay: Every bay is full. Install an Expansion Plate for another.
message.workbay.reject.no_machine: %s has nothing running inside it. A bay can only hold a block with a block entity.
message.workbay.reject.no_ports: %s has no item, fluid or energy ports. A bus would have nothing to connect to.
message.workbay.reject.not_a_block: %s isn't a block. A bay holds machines.
message.workbay.reject.pack_denied: This pack doesn't allow %s to be hosted.
message.workbay.reject.recursion: A Workbay can't go inside a Workbay.
message.workbay.reject.world_interacting: %s works on the world around it. A bay is empty, so it would have nothing to do.
message.workbay.room_created: Workbay %s created and bound to your account. Lose the block and a fresh, uncrafted Workbay picks the same one back up.
message.workbay.upgrade_maxed: This Workbay already has as many of those as it takes.
message.workbay.upgrade_missing: You don't have one of those to install.
tooltip.workbay.connector_unpaired: Not paired. Right-click a Workbay with this to pair it.
